title: Erewash Rag
excerpt: An satirical news site where all the articles are AI generated
content: I created erewashrag.com as a fun project to 1. annoy my friend who is a Borough Councillor and 2. try out some new technologies. The UI is built using React and calls a RESTful API to retrieve articles.
